hero.tagline: The classic Parcheesi board game — reimagined with the thrill of playing cards. No dice. Pure strategy.

teams.title: 4 Players, 2 Teams
teams.description: Partner up and coordinate your moves. Team A plays P1 & P3, Team B plays P2 & P4. Strategy runs deep.

cards.title: Cards Decide Everything
cards.description: Aces & Kings enter pawns. Sevens split across two pawns. Jacks let you swap. Every card opens new possibilities.

win.title: Win as a Team
win.description: Race all 8 of your team's pawns into the finish area before the other team does. Two win — or none do.

howToPlay.label: How It Works
howToPlay.title: Get started in four easy steps

deal.title: Deal the Cards
deal.desc: Cards are dealt in three rounds: 5, 4, then 4. The dealer rotates after each full set of rounds.

enter.title: Enter the Board
enter.desc: Play an Ace or King to bring a pawn from reserve onto your home position.

race.title: Race Forward
race.desc: Move your pawns around the 64-space board using your cards. Special cards unlock special moves.

finish.title: Finish Together
finish.desc: Guide all 4 of your pawns — and help your teammate do the same. First team done wins!

cta.title: Ready to play CardCheesi?
cta.sub: Gather your friends, shuffle the deck, and let the race begin.
